thread:
alyssa: Quick triage — ran a host-side CPU flamegraph on canary (commit f2a7b9c) for the parsing stack. Tokenizer ticked up to ~28% CPU (was ~8% last week). grpc writev shows a lot of tiny writes contributing to syscall overhead.
ben: ugh. did you correlate with kv-cache hit rate?
alyssa: yes. kvcache cold misses spiked during the window. miss rate ~12% -> 37% for a short burst. suspect small-request churn + new kernel-selection fallback landed in the same deploy.
miao: which fallback? the microbatch->no-kernel switch from PR #2147 ?
alyssa: yeh — rollout 42 enabled adaptive kernel fallback for long sequences. hypothesis: fallback path serializes tokens differently, causing more fragmentation on the host frames when streaming.
sam: can you paste the top flame lines and the writev sample?
alyssa: pasted below:

--- flame snippet ---
tokenize_bytes()
  parse_stream_frag()
    grpc_writev()
      writev_syscall()
        epoll_wait()

sampled 5000 stacks, 60s window. writev syscall called ~4.2k times; median payload 512B. many 1-3 frame writes.
--- end ---

ben: 1) batching heuristic might be creating too-small chunks. 2) kernel fallback may change serialization chunk boundaries. 3) kvcache misses amplify work.
ben: quick check suggestion: run canary with kernel_fallback=false and adaptive_batching=off
alyssa: did that for a 15m run — writev count dropped 70%, tokenization CPU down to 10% (still slightly higher than baseline)
miao: that points to kernel fallback + batching interaction. we should look at the boundary math in the parser: host currently splits frames at token boundaries, but fallback path appends small encoded segments.
sam: low-effort mitigation: coalesce small writes on host before writev. add a tiny buffer + write threshold (1KB) in proxy.
ben: agree. also add kvcache sampling to trace the miss spike origin (route IDs).
alyssa: created issue #4321 and a small PR for host coalesce (WIP). infra-bot: deploy-canary started for pr/host-coalesce at 3167891250 :rocket:
infra-bot: canary metrics: writev_count -65% at t+5m, p95 latency +8ms (expected due to small buffering), cpu_tokenize -12%.
miao: we should avoid perf regression on p95 latency. propose config flag coalesce_max_delay=2ms behind a feature flag for relaxable tradeoff.
sam: agreed. add telemetry for 'coalesce_delay' tag and track p50/p95.
alyssa: next steps: 1) land host coalesce behind ff, 2) revert kernel_fallback rollout until audit, 3) kvcache root-cause tracing. assigning ben/miao for 2/3.
ben: on it. will open revert PR and instrument kernel-selection decision path.
miao: will add kvcache tracing and a lightweight sample sink.
sam: i'll shepherd the canary and keep p95 SLO dashboard open.
alyssa: thanks all. will update issue #4321 with perf numbers and a short postmortem draft.
ben: :thumbsup:
